student.goal: Score strongly on CKAD, CKA, CKS and the Anthropic certs (CCAO-F, CCDV-F, CCAR-F, CCAR-P).

settings.suggestedCadence: About 70% time on the DevOps line, 30% on Anthropic. Switch to single-focus sprints before an exam.

gatingRules.withinLevel: Project N+1 unlocks only after Project N is completed.
gatingRules.withinTrack: The next level unlocks only after every project in the current level is completed.
gatingRules.devopsLine: Docker Beginner unlocks after Linux Beginner is complete. Kubernetes Beginner unlocks after Docker Beginner is complete. Higher levels still follow the within-track rule.
gatingRules.kubernetesCert: Certification level unlocks after Kubernetes Advanced is complete. CKS unlocks only after CKA is complete.
gatingRules.anthropicLine: Fully independent. Starts unlocked. Never blocked by the DevOps line.
gatingRules.englishLine: Fully independent. Starts unlocked. Never blocked by other tracks. Strict order within a level (Lesson N+1 unlocks after Lesson N is completed).
gatingRules.weakAreaGate: If a mock/timed exam scores a domain below threshold, that domain is added to weakAreas and blocks the next stage until remediation passes.
